hook.text: Google's AMP for Email lets you shop, RSVP, and book inside the email itself. No clicking through.

buildup.text: AMP adds interactive elements: carousels, forms, real-time pricing, and live inventory—all inside the email body.

discovery.text: Early adopters saw 20% higher conversion rates. Removing the click-to-website step reduces friction and dropout.

twist.text: Most email clients don't fully support AMP yet. Gmail does, Apple Mail doesn't. Adoption is slow but growing.

climax.text: AMP emails require copy that works as interface text: button labels, form prompts, confirmation messages.

punchline.text: Shop inside the email. AMP turns the inbox into a storefront.

quiz.question: What does AMP for Email enable?
options: Interactive experiences like shopping inside the email

details.summary: AMP for Email, launched by Google in 2019, allows interactive elements inside emails — carousels, forms, real-time content, and dynamic updates. Subscribers can browse products, fill surveys, or RSVP without leaving the inbox. It transforms email from a static document into a mini application.
details.whyItMatters: AMP for Email represents the biggest evolution in email capabilities since HTML. Interactive emails could dramatically increase engagement by removing friction between reading and acting.
takeaways: AMP allows interactive elements like forms and carousels inside emails
Users can take actions without leaving the inbox
Adoption has been slow due to limited email client support

faq.question: Which email clients support AMP for Email?
faq.answer: Gmail, Yahoo Mail, and Mail.ru support AMP emails. Notably, Apple Mail, Outlook, and many smaller clients do not. This limited support means brands must create fallback HTML versions, increasing production complexity.

faq.question: What can you do with AMP emails that you cannot do with HTML?
faq.answer: Display real-time content (live inventory counts, updated prices), embed interactive forms and surveys, show image carousels users can swipe, and update content after the email is sent. These capabilities turn email from a snapshot into a living document.
